text:
liam: Heads-up — rolled q4b-ptx into canary yesterday. Early perf looks fine overall but recall on rare intents dropped ~12% vs baseline. Suspect promptset overlap + dedupe mistake. Anyone on curation/labeling to sync? cc @maria @kevin

maria: on it, can you paste the eval run id and the small metric snippet?

liam: eval id `eval/1753219876-q4b-canary` 

liam: Quick metrics snapshot:
```
baseline (qx3b): rare_recall=0.78
q4b-ptx canary: rare_recall=0.69
overall_f1 ~ 0.82 (no large change)
```

maria: that's a noticeable drop for tail intents. Are the failing cases concentrated in any anchor cohorts (long prompts / multisentence)?

kevin: labeler/curation note: we merged anchorbank-v2 last week and loosened fuzzy join thresh from 0.88 -> 0.82 to reduce fragmentation. Could have merged near-paraphrases incorrectly. I'll scope a dedupe sweep against the canary holdout.

ashok: labelling capacity: we can prioritize a small golden relabel. How many high-priority samples do you want?

liam: created sample set `rare_canary_top500` in s3://redwood-curation/canaries/1753219876. Prioritize items with model-confusion >=2 and confidence delta < 0.15. If we get a golden relabel of ~200 that should give a quick signal.

maria: also want to run tokenizer delta — q4b-ptx uses tokenizer v2-trim; tokenization can change fingerprinting and dedupe. I'll run a token-diff pass and post overlaps.

kevin: starting dedupe job now (posting command)
```
python tools/dedupe.py --input s3://redwood-curation/canaries/1753219876/rare_canary_top500.jsonl --method fuzzy --thresh 0.82 --out s3://redwood-curation/canaries/1753219876/dedupe_pass1.jsonl
```

kevin: first pass shows ~9% duplicates flagged, mostly short paraphrase near-duplicates and a handful of HTML-entity variants. Dropping those should reduce noise.

liam: good catch. Plan of action: (1) kevin produces cleaned set + manifest, (2) ashok coordinates 200 golden relabels from that cleaned set, (3) maria runs tokenizer fingerprint delta, (4) liam re-evals canary with the cleaned/golden set and current quant profile. Target timeline ~24h for initial signal.

ashok: can commit to 200 golden by EOD tomorrow if kevin hands off the cleaned manifest. I'll mark priority on the task.

maria: token-delta job running, should have diff in ~3h. I'll flag any systematic tokenization mismatches.

kevin: dedupe job complete, pushed cleaned file and manifest to s3 and created ticket: https://redwood.internal/curation/tickets/7621. Summary: removed 46 duplicates, normalized entity encodings.

liam: thanks — once ashok has the golden labels, I'll run a focused eval and check if recall gap closes. If regression remains, we should try a lightweight prompt template calibration (soft prompt tweaks + few-shot anchor) before adjusting quant.

maria: also adding a micro-golden set of 50 high-impact pairs (high confusion score) for a quick smoke test. tagging @ashok to prioritize those first. :thumbsup:

ashok: acknowledged. I'll allocate labellers and update ticket 7621 with progress and ETA.

liam: perfect — please keep updates in this thread. If anyone spots an obvious label drift or ingestion bug, ping me asap. Thanks!
